atoms.text: This is a picture of the landscape of Zion National Park. In the foreground, there are several small trees and the so-called Virgin River. Although there are lots of plants, the ground is partly covered with stones. The sandy nature reminds of a desert. In the background, there are canyons of orange sandstone. The biggest one is called the Watchman. The weather seems to be nice, but it is also cloudy.

atoms.b: This picture shows a ((++nature urban)) scene at Katmai National Park.
There are lots of ((++brown_bears wolves)) catching fish in the water.
In the centre of the picture, there is a small ((++waterfall tree)) – the Brooks Falls in the Brooks River.
The bears are on top of the waterfall as well as ((++at_its_bottom in_the_middle)). They are searching for salmon.
((++In_the_background At_the_bottom)), there are lots of trees.
The river seems to be flowing through ((++a_forest mountains)).
The atmosphere in the picture is calm, the weather is ((++good bad)) and the sun is shining.
